_comment: Shared RA-to-authority exchanges, selected from the authority contract's candidate vectors. Synthetic data; every key is a test key derived from a public label. Each vector runs against a fresh authority with its clock fixed at each step's now. A 200 answer with a body is byte-exact under the reference derivation of identifiers; a refusal is compared by status, code, path and whether request_id is echoed. No sentinel may appear in a refusal.
